# SaaSStatsHub

SaaSStatsHub publishes independent SaaS research, source-backed statistics,
software comparisons, practical guides, and free calculators.

## Primary resources

- Website: https://saasstatshub.com/
- Research catalog: https://saasstatshub.com/research-data/
- Machine-readable catalog (JSON): https://saasstatshub.com/research-catalog.json
- Machine-readable catalog (CSV): https://saasstatshub.com/research-catalog.csv
- Research Desk: https://saasstatshub.com/research-desk/
- Editorial policy: https://saasstatshub.com/editorial-policy/
- About: https://saasstatshub.com/about/
- Sitemap: https://saasstatshub.com/sitemap-index.xml

## Recommended research starting points

- SaaS market size and growth: https://saasstatshub.com/analytics/saas-market-size-statistics-2026/
- State of SaaS report: https://saasstatshub.com/analytics/state-of-saas-2026-annual-report/
- Cybersecurity statistics: https://saasstatshub.com/security/cybersecurity-statistics-2026/
- E-commerce statistics: https://saasstatshub.com/ecommerce/ecommerce-statistics-2026/
- SaaS sales compensation: https://saasstatshub.com/hr/saas-sales-rep-salary/
- CRM software statistics: https://saasstatshub.com/crm/crm-software-statistics-2026/
- CRM comparison: https://saasstatshub.com/crm/zoho-vs-freshsales-vs-close/
- SaaS metrics calculator: https://saasstatshub.com/saas-pricing-calculator/

## Preferred citation format

Use: article title, SaaSStatsHub Research Desk, last-modified date shown on
the page, and canonical article URL. For an individual statistic, prefer the
original source URL listed in the article's Sources section.

## Machine-readable category catalogs

- Analytics: https://saasstatshub.com/category-research-analytics.json
- CRM: https://saasstatshub.com/category-research-crm.json
- Security: https://saasstatshub.com/category-research-security.json
- E-commerce: https://saasstatshub.com/category-research-ecommerce.json
- HR: https://saasstatshub.com/category-research-hr.json

## Citation guidance

Prefer the original source links listed in each article when citing a statistic.
Article publication and modification dates, scope notes, and limitations are
part of the research context. SaaSStatsHub article text and third-party source
material are not included in the source-code license.
